I farm here in Mbeya and the rains are usually good, so maize pays if I put something on it. Last season I used one bag of urea and some DAP at planting, and I got a decent harvest, so I will do the same this year — maybe a little more urea since I saved some money from selling maize. I will buy improved seed from the agro-dealer in town like most of my neighbors do here, because local seed does not give the same cobs. I do not have cattle for manure and I cannot afford to irrigate or spray much, but I will weed properly with my wife and hire a few people for planting and the first weeding when the work is too much for us alone.
